name: SISTER
author: hundekraft
description: SISTER is Father's sister: a long stereo hall with three voices in its tail. Turn green toward the choir and the tail sings back what you played, on slowly drifting vowels (aah, ooh, eeh), like a choir far down the nave. At the other end it rings on organ pipes tuned to a root, its fifth and its octave, so drums and noise come back as a chord. White turns the tail around: each sound swells up backwards out of its own echo before it lands. Nothing switches modes.
